It also provides a clear mechanism (the high entropy effect, the sluggish kinetic diffusion effect, the severe lattice distortion effect, and the cocktail effect) and a decisive falsification test (comparison of mechanical properties of RHEAs produced by spark plasma sintering and traditional methods). Additionally, C3 has a well-defined material initial state (RHEAs with a body-centered cubic crystal structure) and conditions (high-temperature applications), making it a more precise and testable hypothesis compared to the other candidates.
